screenshots.title: OTP-based authentication
screenshots.alt: Veyrix chat displaying its email or mobile sign-in form with a six-digit verification code field
screenshots.caption: Customers verify their identity before accessing the shopping conversation.

screenshots.title: Delivery address selection
screenshots.alt: Veyrix chat showing a saved address card with a Deliver here and review button
screenshots.caption: Choose a saved address or add a new one before reviewing the order.

screenshots.title: Order confirmation review
screenshots.alt: Veyrix chat showing an order review card with item details, delivery address and a Confirm order button
screenshots.caption: Review items, delivery details and total before placing a pay-on-delivery order.

screenshots.title: Cancellation review
screenshots.alt: Veyrix chat showing a cancellation review card with order details and a Confirm cancellation button
screenshots.caption: Eligible orders can be cancelled before dispatch through an explicit confirmation.

screenshots.title: Order cancelled
screenshots.alt: Veyrix chat confirming that the order has been successfully cancelled
screenshots.caption: The full cancellation flow from request to confirmed cancellation.
